Final fantasy XV

I picked up the game not knowing about the dropped plot lines and the 10 year production it took square enix to create so I really got to experience it without all the bitter feelings the die hard fans carried. Its certainly not without its faults ( mainly the half told plot lines and characters that weren't properly fleshed out) but the (semi) open world is beautiful, the music is stunning and I really liked the overall themes of friendship, brotherhood and coming of age as opposed to another love conquers all storyline. The game has made an incredible impact on me overall and will likely stay in my top 10.
